subject: Request: temporary burst window and blended overrun pricing
messages:
From: Beth Alvarez <beth@brightlayer.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Alan Cho <alan@brightlayer.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch week capacity help - temporary burst request

Hi Marissa,

We have a hard launch scheduled for next Monday and early traffic projections keep rising — we now expect a 5x spike in inference volume for a 36-hour window. Can Redwood provide a temporary quota uplift and a short-term rate-limit increase to cover the launch window?

Quick points:
- Window: 2028-06-11 00:00 UTC -> 2028-06-12 12:00 UTC (36 hours)
- Expected additional tokens: ~18M tokens across the window
- We'd like a blended overrun price rather than pay per-token at list for this short period

What we need from Redwood: committed short-window capacity (burst) + an overrun true-up option and a one-off discount that we can present to our CFO. We are a month away from signing a 12-month committed plan (still finalizing legal), so hoping for a customer-friendly short-term arrangement.

Can you advise pricing and what information you need to enable this quickly?

Thanks,
Beth
Beth Alvarez
VP Product, BrightLayer
beth@brightlayer.ai
(415) 555-0198

[Attachment: launch-week-traffic-estimates.csv]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Beth Alvarez <beth@brightlayer.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity help - temporary burst request

Hi Beth —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the launch. We can cover a temporary uplift; below is an initial proposal to move fast while protecting both sides.

Proposal (fast option):
- Temporary quota increase: +5x baseline throughput for 36 hours (matching your window).
- Blended overrun price for the window: $0.0075 per token (this is a waived portion over our standard overrun rate).
- Commitment credit: if BrightLayer signs the pending 12-month commit within 30 days, we will apply a one-time credit of 20% of the charges incurred during the burst (applied to first invoice after contract start).
- Guardrails: explicit cap of 20M tokens authorized; any usage above that reverts to standard overrun pricing unless pre-approved.

What we need from you to finalize same-day:
1) Confirmation of the exact UTC window and whether the 36-hr window is flexible by +/- 6 hours.
2) Final traffic CSV (looks like you attached one — thanks) and expected peak tokens per minute so we can size the rate limit.
3) PO or email confirmation that CFO will accept a one-time credit (we can draft SOW addendum).

I’ve looped in Jordan (sales ops) to size the rate-limit and Lauren (sales leadership) for approvals on the credit. Jordan — can you confirm technical feasibility and the rate-limit floor by EOD?

I’ll prepare a short SOW addendum and send it over for signatures once we have confirmation.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: none]

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, beth@brightlayer.ai
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity help - temporary burst request

Marissa / Beth — quick tech note from ops:

We can stand up a temporary rate-limit profile scoped to the BrightLayer API key with the following params:
- Peak tokens/min cap: 1.2M tokens/min (sustained) with elevated allocator for the window.
- Warm pool: enable additional warm instances to avoid cold-start tails (adds modest cost).
- Enforcement: soft throttles at 90% of cap for first 6 hours so we can monitor spikes and adjust.

Timing: we need final peak tokens/min and the approved window by 18:00 PT on Thursday to guarantee provisioning.

Neha, can you confirm the pricing math for the blended rate and credit path? I drafted a simple worksheet and attached it.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Pricing-Options-BrightLayer.xlsx]

Thanks Marissa and Jordan — all good so far. Quick answers:
- Window is firm: 2028-06-11 00:00 UTC -> 2028-06-12 12:00 UTC (no drift).
- Peak tokens/min: we estimate short spikes up to 1.05M tokens/min (sustained peaks closer to 600–700k).
- CFO is comfortable with the one-time credit approach as long as we get the SOW addendum and a DocuSign link today.

Please send the SOW addendum and a DocuSign so we can get procurement to sign. We’ll plan to finalize the 12-month commit next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Beth
